row.body: The route map points to a residence, but the weapon handover form says the occupant was already marked missing. The return route has no driver.
row.title: Do not fire at the house

cites.quote: Sure this was where he lived

sidecar.gloss: A missing-person mark precedes the weapon handover.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field crew could have left security equipment at an empty property; the missing driver does not identify who was expected.
